# Format: 128 data lines of 1024 lowercase hex digits each, no separators. Lines 1-64 are
# LTC_MAT_1 rows j = 0..63; lines 65-128 are LTC_MAT_2 rows j = 0..63. Each line holds 64
# texels i = 0..63 x 4 channels; texel (i, j) starts at source index (j*64 + i)*4 and each
# value is the IEEE 754 binary16 (round to nearest even) of the source float, written as 4
# lowercase hex digits per channel, in r, g, b, a order.
